name: Futago Haha
source:
With my parents frequently traveling abroad for business, I'm left living with my aunt and also my mother's twin sister Nanami. 

One day, the lustful affection I have for my mother has driven me to rape her twin sister Nanami in anger. It is then that I discovered that Nanami was a virgin. From that day onwards, the days of Nanami being violated by me continues, all the while keeping it a secret from my mother Mutsumi.

However, one day when I violated Nanami, I discovered it was not my aunt that I raped, but my own mother Mutsumi who was pretending to be Nanami...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=701104]Getchu[/url]]
